title: Classic Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional and flavorful North African stew originating from the Tagine pottery dish. This recipe serves a hearty and aromatic lamb tagine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Brown the lamb chunks until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger; cook for 1 minute.
Add cumin, cinnamon, and paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and chicken broth; bring to a boil.
Return lamb to the pot and cover with a tight-fitting lid.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and cook for 2 hours or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
